samples.question: The image is split into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) by two light-gray crossed divider lines. Inside each quadrant there is one dark filled circle and one dark bar (a thick straight line). In exactly one quadrant the circle and the bar overlap each other, so the two dark shapes touch and merge into a single connected blob. In the other three quadrants the circle sits clearly away from the bar with a visible gap between them. Which quadrant contains the only pair in which the circle and the bar overlap each other? Answer with one quadrant name.
